modmenu.summaryTranslation.mrtoolbar: Tool slots in the hotbar - client part of the MRtoolbar plugin.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mrtoolbar: Client mod for the Paper plugin MRtoolbar (required there for the toolbar): freely bindable keys, highlighted tool slots in the hotbar and a hotbar design screen to match your texture pack. Does nothing on servers without the plugin.
mrtoolbar.message.incompatible: MRtoolbar: the plugin on this server (%s) does not fit your mod version - the toolbar is off here.
mrtoolbar.status.offline: Not connected to a server - preview only.
mrtoolbar.status.incompatible: MRtoolbar on the server (%s) does not fit this mod version.
mrtoolbar.status.paused: Connected to MRtoolbar %s - toolbar is off right now (world, admin mode, switched off?).
mrtoolbar.design.title: MRtoolbar – Hotbar design
mrtoolbar.design.hint: Preview with your resource pack: slots 1 and 3 are tool slots, slot 3 is selected.
